table.$description: Table rows, header band and footer, shared by Table and DataTable. Every colour is a semantic surface or border role referenced through its --qx-color-* variable, so one declaration re-themes in light and dark. Hover is a translucent wash rather than an opaque surface because a table sits on cards, canvases and sunken wells alike; selection is the quiet Qeet tint plus a ≥3:1 brand indicator bar, so it never rests on the tint alone.
